title: Jacobs records denied and mailbox blown up
summary: Robert Hastings tells of Jacobs records denied and mailbox blown up, about after 1964 at Vandenberg Space Force Base, California, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Jacobs's farm; Vandenberg Air Force Base records

tellings.quote: they denied there was ever a Robert Jacobs in the Air Force he gets a phone call one night he and his wife come home from a movie the phone rings the voice says your mailbox Al light what a beautiful sight you're going down
